rules.title: Config from the environment
rules.text: Read configuration from environment variables with typed parsing and sensible defaults.

rules.title: Provide .env.example
rules.text: Document every variable in .env.example without real values.

rules.title: Validate at startup
rules.text: Validate configuration once at startup and fail with a clear message.

rules.title: No environment branching in code
rules.text: Avoid branching on environment names in code; inject behavior through configuration.

rules.title: Safe defaults
rules.text: Default to the secure, least-privileged and non-destructive option.
